newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba, St. Vincent sign economic agreement.
newsitem.headline: Cuba, St. Vincent sign economic agreement.

text.p: Cuban and St. Vincent have signed an agreement opening the door to economic, scientific and technological cooperation, the ruling Communist Party newspaper Granma reported on Wednesday.
President Fidel Castro signed the accord with St. Vincent Prime Minister James Mitchell, who started an official visit to Cuba last Saturday, it said.
Mitchell was the third Caribbean prime minister to pay an official visit to Cuba in recent weeks, following Keith Mitchell of Grenada and P.J. Patterson of Jamaica.

Granma quoted Cuban Foreign Minister Roberto Robaina as saying that Cuba and St. Vincent were advancing "on the road to communications and interchange" despite what he called U.S. attempts to isolate Cuba.
Mitchell spoke out in favor of Cuba's integration into the Caribbean Community, a grouping of 14 nations, it said.
